OWNER_MISMATCH.description: A stated owner is not on the beneficial-ownership register.

DIRECTOR_MISMATCH.description: A stated director is not a registered officer of the company.

DISQUALIFIED_DIRECTOR.description: A stated director appears on the disqualified directors register.

STATUS_MISMATCH.description: The company is dissolved, struck off or in liquidation at the snapshot date.

SANCTIONS_HIT.description: A stated director or owner matches a sanctions list entry.

CLONED_WEBSITE.description: The website text is copied from another company's site.

ADDRESS_MASS_REG.description: The registered office hosts more than 500 companies.

NEW_DOMAIN.description: The website domain was created less than 30 days before the snapshot date.

ACTIVITY_MISMATCH.description: The stated industry does not match the registered industry codes or the website.

VOLUME_IMPLAUSIBLE.description: The expected monthly volume is implausible for a company of this age and size.

ADDRESS_REJECTED.description: The registered office is the Companies House default address: the registrar rejected the company's own address.
